description: Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement de Bretagne: wastewater datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement de Bretagne. Coverage: Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement de Bretagne. The listing groups 9 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wastewater; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: PAOT 2022-2027 - Actions prévues en Bretagne - Assainissement / Boues ; PAOT 2022-2027 - Actions prévues en Bretagne - Assainissement / Non co; PAOT 2022-2027 - Actions prévues en Bretagne - Assainissement / Réseau; PAOT 2022-2027 - Actions prévues en Bretagne - Assainissement / Statio. Formats seen: WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
